nav.menu_entry: Getting started

page.title: Getting started — Ledger AI
page.meta_description: Create your account, answer seven short questions about your business, and Ledger builds your first working day. No card to start.
page.hero_h1: Set up Ledger in seven short steps.
page.hero_lead: Answer a few plain questions about your business — what you do, how you charge, when you're open. Skip any of them; only the kind of business is required. Ledger turns your answers into your price list, your hours and your first working day, and its AI, voice assistant and Front Desk all read the same brief.
page.join_1_text: Email and password. Your 14-day free trial starts now — no card.
page.join_2_text: One tap on the link we send.
page.join_3_text: Business name and currency. That's the whole form.
page.join_4_text: Most are a tap. Skip any of them and finish later from Settings.
page.join_5_text: Switches on your AI credit for the trial. No card.
page.join_closing: Then Ledger shows your first working day — the next steps for your business, picked from what you told it. Change any answer later in Settings under What Ledger knows.
page.steps_1_text: What kind of business, how long you've been at it, team size, where you're based.
page.steps_2_text: What you sell or do, with prices. How you charge, and whether you quote first.
page.steps_3_text: Who you serve, how they reach you, where the work happens.
page.steps_4_text: When you're open, what happens after hours, how soon you can take a job.
page.steps_5_text: How customers pay, when payment is due, whether you take a deposit.
page.steps_6_text: Who's on the team, whether Ledger answers missed calls and texts, QuickBooks and Google Calendar.
page.steps_7_text: How it should sound, what matters this year, rules it must always follow, what it may do on its own.
page.try_h2: Try the seven steps right now
page.try_sub: No account needed. This is the same seven-step setup with the same questions, running right here. Nothing you type leaves this page.
page.try_after: When you sign up you'll answer for real inside the app — this preview doesn't carry over.

footage.1_desc: Kind of business, team size, where you're based. Mostly taps.
footage.2_desc: Your services and prices become your price list.
footage.3_desc: One last look. Change anything before you finish.
footage.4_desc: A short plan built from your answers, not a generic checklist.

home.h2: Set up in seven short steps.
home.p: Tell Ledger what you do, how you charge and when you're open. Skip anything. It builds your price list, your hours and your first working day from your answers — and you can try the steps before you sign up.
home.day1_old: Create your account, connect QuickBooks — or use the built-in books if you don't have it — and ask your first question.
home.day1_new: Create your account, answer seven short questions about your business, connect QuickBooks — or use the built-in books if you don't have it — and ask your first question.

preview.done_p: In the app, Ledger turns these answers into your price list, your hours and your first working day. Sign up and you'll answer for real — it takes the same seven steps.
